Fixed: added 6 mappings (all verified against real files; User -> prisma model User; AuthenticationService -> auth API routes), budget current_usage 43->49, metrics re-measured (158 non-test src files, db mappings 3->4, api mappings 6->7). Bloat check: 49/80 terms (61%), 0 drafts, queue empty, 0 unmapped -> HEALTHY. Observation: AuthorizationService carries layer value 'application' (non-standard vs core/domain/aux) — left as-is (minimal diff), flagged as open risk.
